description: This file defines the ViewHandler interface for the OFBiz web application framework, specifying methods for rendering views, initializing handlers, and preparing view contexts.

classes.name: ViewHandler
classes.description: Interface defining methods for handling view rendering and processing in the OFBiz web framework.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the view handler as declared in the controller configuration file.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the view handler as declared in the controller configuration file.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler; intended to be called once, using the ServletContext to perform setup based on configuration files.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the specified view given its parameters and context, handling the HTTP request and response objects.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares and secures the view context before rendering, based on the request, response, and view configuration.
